high_level_description: The image is divided into two distinct sections. On the left side, there is a fashion runway scene. A model is walking down the runway, showcasing a stylish outfit. The model is wearing a dark blue denim jacket over a patterned shirt with a high collar, paired with light blue striped shorts. The model also has a green scarf draped around their neck and is carrying a brown shoulder bag. The audience on either side of the runway is seated, attentively watching the model. Some individuals in the audience are taking photos or videos with their phones.
